reviews.title: Great for Raspberry Pi 5
reviews.comment: Used with a Raspberry Pi 5 (and Pimodori nvme adapter) - great price - size is large enough for a Pi 5 running Home Assistant - speed if perfectly fine given that the P1 has a very limited PCIe connection to the drive.
reviews.author: T.Perraut

reviews.title: A great ssd time machine.
reviews.comment: This internal M.2 SSD which I nstalled on a Mini 4 Doc works great. It servers as a SSD time machine on the M4 mini. The first thing I did was to program it and format it using the apple software,  easy to follow up. The installation was just too easy.
